_description: Module -> spec coverage map (N-2, 2026-10-20 audit). Every runtime Lua module must appear here with at least one spec exercising it, OR an explicit non-empty 'reason' documenting why it ships without a dedicated spec (device-only glue, trivial delegation). Enforced by tools/check_module_map.py in CI: fails on missing/stale entries, spec-less modules without a reason, non-existent specs, and orphan spec files. When adding a module, add its entry in the same change; when adding a spec, reference it from the covered module.

_excluded._meta.lua: declarative plugin metadata (version/name), no runtime logic; gated by the version-consistency checks

main.lua.reason: KOReader plugin entry point: wiring only (creates dispatcher, registers UI/menu/Downloads, forwards events). Syntax-gated by luac -p strict 5.1 and smoke-tested on device; all logic lives in weread/lib + weread/ui modules that carry their own specs.

reader_menu_order.lua.reason: Declarative KOReader menu-order table (data, no logic); consumed by KOReader's menu framework on device.

weread/lib/crypto.lua.reason: ffi-backed device-only primitives (LuaJIT ffi/libcrypto): cannot load under the plain Lua 5.1 spec runtime. Contract is pinned by spec/protocol_spec.lua via a deterministic stub, and the real implementations are exercised on device.

weread/lib/foreground_barrier.lua.reason: Device-only foreground/background timing glue around UIManager events; depends on a live UIManager loop that the spec runtime cannot provide. Its decisions are driven by reader_lifecycle state which is exercised via downloader integration on device.

weread/lib/global_state.lua.reason: Trivial shared-state table holder (get/set of a single state table consumed by foreground_barrier/reader_lifecycle/ui.common); no branches to test.

weread/lib/library_db.lua.reason: Device-only sqlite/ffi storage wrapper; requires the on-device database runtime. Schema behaviour is exercised on device; consumers (migrations, main wiring) are gated by luac -p and device smoke tests.

weread/lib/logger.lua.reason: Trivial logging wrapper over ffi/util (prefix + level filtering, no branches); direct assertions would only restate its one-liner implementation.

weread/lib/migrations.lua.reason: Schema migration glue on top of the device-only library_db/sqlite runtime; migration results are verified on device upgrade paths. Pure transformations it contains are covered indirectly by settings/content specs.

weread/lib/mixin.lua.reason: Trivial OOP helper (class/inherit one-liner); no branches.

weread/lib/reader_lifecycle.lua.reason: Device-only lifecycle glue (KReader page events -> sync/pull drivers); requires live reader UI events. Its pure helpers are exercised indirectly through downloader/progress_sync integration on device.

weread/lib/reader_state.lua.reason: Device-only provider of the live reader document state (page/progress accessors); cannot be instantiated without a real document. Consumers are covered by content/downloader specs via stubs.

weread/lib/scan.lua.reason: Device-only directory scan for cache cleanup (consumed by ui.cache); touches the on-device cache tree layout. Path traversal safety is covered by spec/path_guard_spec.lua which gates the shared path utilities it uses.

weread/ui/common.lua.reason: KOReader widget glue (dialog/toast helpers around UIManager); requires the live widget runtime. Logic-free forwarding to global_state/logger.

weread/ui/download_dialog.lua.reason: KOReader DownloadDialog widget: pure UI presentation driven by weread.lib.downloader (which carries its own specs); no decisions of its own beyond widget callbacks.

weread/ui/end_of_book_dialog.lua.reason: KOReader end-of-book dialog widget: presentation-only, actions delegate to progress_sync/reader_navigation which carry their own specs.

weread/ui/library.lua.reason: KOReader bookshelf UI: presentation over weread.lib.book_store/content (both spec-covered); interactive behaviour verified on device.

weread/ui/menu.lua.reason: KOReader menu registration glue: declarative item table plus enabled_func wiring over progress_sync:status() (spec-covered); interactive behaviour verified on device.

weread/ui/progress_sync_dialog.lua.reason: KOReader sync-progress dialog widget: presentation over weread.lib.progress_sync (spec-covered).

weread/ui/read_report.lua.reason: KOReader reading-report UI: presentation over weread.lib.read_report + weread.lib.read_stats (both spec-covered).

weread/ui/read_stats_view.lua.reason: KOReader stats view widget: presentation over weread.lib.read_stats (spec-covered).

weread/ui/reader_navigation.lua.reason: KOReader page-event glue: forwards reader events to progress_sync/downloader (spec-covered); no decisions of its own beyond delegation.
